mappingLimitations: Provisional canonical-token correspondence, not reviewed acceptable pronunciation variants.
Vowel length, dialect and stress distinctions are simplified; ER maps to the rhotic token ɚ at every stress.
Canonical AA+R states remain separate although the decoder has merged tokens such as ɑːɹ; this mismatch can distort estimated boundaries.
Canonical T/D use t/d rather than the flap ɾ; L uses l rather than ɫ or syllabic variants.
A forced canonical path can assign a target interval when the target was not produced.
preflightSelection: fold 0 inner-fit only; duration-sorted shortest, middle, longest, with utterance ID tie-break
